pcrecomp.note: Pinned upstream submodule with the port lifter patch.

launcher.note: Bundled source snapshot of the shared launcher used by this port. PORT_LAUNCHER can select a separate compatible source tree.

mojoshader.note: Pinned upstream submodule with the port shader patch.

glslang.license: BSD-3-Clause, with some files under other permissive licenses; the APK's assets/licenses/glslang.txt carries each compiled file's license header
glslang.note: Compiled into libsims2.so for the native Vulkan renderer's run-time GLSL -> SPIR-V translations (android/render/s2r_glslang.cpp; the file list is GLSLANG_SOURCES in tools/build_android.py).

dlmalloc.note: Upstream 2.8.6 source in the mirror doc/dlalloc-2.8.6/malloc.c; patch retains the previously used 2023 MIT-0 notice.

astcenc.note: Pinned 5.7.0 upstream submodule; library sources are in Source/.

etcpak.note: Pinned upstream submodule; bundled bcdec.h retains its own license.

fidelityfx_fsr1.note: The EASU/RCAS GLSL ES port shared with HoMM5; premultiplied alpha for UI textures.

adrenotools.note: Helper and hooks built from source by the ut3 port's tools/build_turnip.py (NDK 27.2, android-30, c++_shared, 16 KiB pages) and reused unchanged. The native Vulkan renderer (android/render/s2r_vkdriver.c) loads Turnip, PanVK or the player's own driver through them in a linker namespace of their own; the system Vulkan driver is not replaced. Staged in build/vulkan-runtime (or S2_VULKAN_RUNTIME) and checked by tools/build_game_apk.py.

turnip.version: Mesa Turnip 26.0.0 R8 (Turnip_v26.0.0_R8.zip, vulkan.ad07xx.so; Adreno 6xx/7xx, not the A8xx variant; device API 1.3.335)
turnip.license: MIT for Mesa's core; some Mesa components differ. The community build carries no complete license manifest.
turnip.note: Packaged as lib/arm64-v8a/libs2turnip.so (the installer extracts only lib*.so); the launcher's "turnip" renderer mode. The ut3 port verified Vulkan 1.3, BC1-5 and precise occlusion on an Adreno 650 with it. Review its provenance and license manifest before a public release.

panvk.source: The shared reference of all ports: ../launcher/drivers/panvk (MANIFEST.json, panvk-r10.patch, build_panvk.sh, NOTICE.txt); mali-panvk 58f2c55854 with Kraid e7371b07 and the ports' patch 74ae56c6
panvk.note: tools/build_game_apk.py takes libvulkan_panfrost.so and NOTICE.txt from ../launcher/drivers/panvk (S2_PANVK_DIR overrides; else build/vulkan-runtime) and checks both against these pins and the folder's MANIFEST.json; the launcher's "vulkan-panvk" renderer mode. Needs Android API 30 (the library imports the C11 thrd_/mtx_/cnd_ functions of API 30) and 4 KiB kernel pages. Replaces the 6e85bc6f build of Frostpunk's recipe (a subset of this one, see the manifest's history).

libcxx_shared.note: The C++ runtime of the adrenotools libraries.

xz-embedded.note: v2024-12-30 (ARM64 BCJ): the APK's xz-packed engine library is unpacked by android/unpack/unpack.c (libs2xz.so); used unmodified, as in The Void.
